evidenceLevels: Static product/contract examples, not native-runtime parity results. Clock-pair evidence is not a recurrence engine.

cases.scenario: A completes under approved daily date-only fixed rule; no prior generation.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Create B for the next canonical local calendar day and keep A.
cases.seriesEffect: active; advance frontier A to B
cases.occurrenceEffect: A completed; B open with reciprocal lineage
cases.stepEffect: New template-derived Steps open with fresh identities
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: New completion E1 and operation receipt R1 commit with generation A-to-B.

cases.scenario: A is ordinal 1 of a proposed count=1 series.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Complete A; commit proven count exhaustion with no B.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: E1 plus terminal generation outcome and R1; no successor ID.
unresolvedDependencies: Bounded-rule implementation deferred beyond initial subset

cases.scenario: B is ordinal 2 of count=2 after A was reopened and recompleted.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Completing B exhausts count; A recompletion neither refunds nor spends another ordinal.
cases.occurrenceEffect: A and B retained; no C
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: B completion E3 distinct from A events E1/E2; terminal outcome B.

cases.scenario: Validated next local anchor equals inclusive until date.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Create B on that date; never compare end limits as implicit UTC instants.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: E1/R1 record canonical local bound and calculator version.

cases.scenario: Validated next local anchor lies after inclusive until date.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Complete A with proven until exhaustion; no Invalid date task.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: E1 and terminal outcome commit atomically.

cases.scenario: Source says until February 30 and legacy parser normalizes it.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Preserve exact source and quarantine invalid calendar evidence.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No generated task, event or generation receipt.
unresolvedDependencies: Explicit corrected canonical rule and reviewed reprocessing

cases.scenario: Validated rule calculator returns an invalid local date without a verified exhaustion proof.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Reject dependent completion-and-generation transaction as calculation failure, not exhaustion.
cases.seriesEffect: Unchanged; diagnostic retained outside committed result
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No event, generation key or success receipt committed.

cases.scenario: Canonical future rule has count and until; whichever bound is reached first applies.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Validate both bounds fully; never ignore trailing rule text.
cases.seriesEffect: exhausted with all applicable reasons when reached
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Receipt records both evaluated bounds.

cases.scenario: Proposed timed next endpoint is Stockholm 2026-03-29 02:30.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Retain local endpoint; quarantine nonexistent wall time; do not shift to 03:30.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No dependent success event/receipt.
unresolvedDependencies: Timed recurrence deferred; explicit gap resolution policy

cases.scenario: Proposed timed next endpoint is Stockholm 2026-10-25 02:30.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Retain both candidate instants; require reviewed offset selection.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No dependent success event/receipt.
unresolvedDependencies: Timed recurrence deferred; explicit overlap resolution policy

cases.scenario: Explicit midnight endpoint differs from a date-only endpoint.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Preserve time 00:00 versus null; do not promote either to a known completion timestamp.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Unknown completion instant remains null.

cases.scenario: Template revision T1 has two nested nodes, including a historically checked source Step.
cases.proposedNativeResult: B receives S3 and S4, both open, separate from A Steps S1 and S2.
cases.stepEffect: Fresh S3/S4, completionBinding=null, completedAt=null; preserve nesting/content
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: A events untouched; generation receipt lists S3/S4 and template node mapping.

cases.scenario: User edits B title, body, Step parent order or Step content.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Change B only; preserve template T1 and existing A.
cases.stepEffect: B local structure/content changes; IDs retained where nodes retained
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No generation or completion event from content edit.

cases.scenario: User explicitly updates future template to T2 after B already exists.
cases.proposedNativeResult: C, when later generated, uses T2; B retains captured T1 and local edits.
cases.seriesEffect: Active future template=T2, boundary after B
cases.occurrenceEffect: B unchanged; future C captures T2
cases.stepEffect: Removed template node retired; no past Step rewrite
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Template edit receipt distinct from later B-to-C receipt.

cases.scenario: A generated B; A reopened; A completed again using a new operation ID.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Keep B unchanged; record a new completion attempt for A without generating C.
cases.stepEffect: A Steps retained; B Steps untouched
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: E1 uncounted after reopen; E2 current/countable; new command receipt; existing A-to-B generation ledger retained.

cases.scenario: Same completion operation ID and identical canonical payload is retried after acknowledgement loss.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Replay exactly original identities and event; no second event.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: R1 replay returns E1 and original A-to-B outcome before stale expected revision validation.
unresolvedDependencies: Latest acknowledged state must be intact; recovery fence applies

cases.scenario: B was generated from A and then explicitly deleted; A completion is retried/repeated.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Retain B tombstone and spent generation key; pause frontier; never recreate B.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Retry returns original receipt/deletion disposition; new A completion attempt can have a new event only.

cases.scenario: A is deleted after B exists.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Keep B, lineage tombstone A and immutable historical events.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No relink of A Oath to B; no synthetic completion.

cases.scenario: Rule revision V2 is explicitly saved after B exists.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: B keeps V1 endpoints; future B-to-C uses V2 at explicit boundary after B.
cases.occurrenceEffect: B retains captured V1; C captures V2
cases.stepEffect: Template capture independent of rule revision
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Rule edit receipt does not create C or completion event.

cases.scenario: User changes B due date without explicitly changing series schedule.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: B due edit is occurrence-only; fixed series origin/ordinal remains; explicit reschedule-series action required to shift future anchor.
cases.occurrenceEffect: B current endpoint differs from generation-original endpoint
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No completion event from date edit; generation records both original and current reference evidence.

cases.scenario: User cancels the current frontier occurrence.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Cancel occurrence, pause future generation; stopping series is a distinct explicit action.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No counted completion event from cancellation.

cases.scenario: Series is paused while its current occurrence completes.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Record completion without spending generation key; explicit resume/advance can later generate from existing completion binding.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Completion receipt references E1; later advance must not create E2.
unresolvedDependencies: Pause/resume commands deferred; do not expose until tested

cases.scenario: Imported History has missing or ambiguous current completion binding.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Block recurrence adoption pending N1-E binding reconciliation.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No duplicate event from importing completed task.

cases.scenario: Known-corrupt latest generation falls back to ancestor that predates acknowledged A-to-B receipt.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Fence recurrence writes and require reconciliation before any replay or generation.
cases.occurrenceEffect: Potential external B retained as evidence, no B2 created
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Absence of R1 in recovered ancestor is not permission to regenerate.
unresolvedDependencies: Approved host recovery fence and verified reconciliation

cases.scenario: Private Resource task is mounted in shared Itacan or Obsidian Hub.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Generate only within original Resource owner; exclude private source/history/Oath/receipt evidence from Project export.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Private event/receipt remains private.

cases.scenario: Two offline devices create B1 and B2 for the same stable A generation key.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Preserve both branches and immutable events; quarantine/pause conflict; no timestamp winner.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Local receipts do not establish distributed uniqueness.
unresolvedDependencies: N4 shared lineage transport and conflict resolution

cases.scenario: Existing operation ID is submitted with a different canonical payload.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Reject operation identity conflict before mutation.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No replay of mismatched request; no new event.

cases.scenario: Rule or template uses unsupported future contract version.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Preserve raw versioned evidence; reject generation without downcasting.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No success receipt for unsupported operation.
unresolvedDependencies: Reviewed new version and explicit reprocessing

cases.scenario: Legacy recurrence has neither Start nor Due nor scheduled date.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Quarantine date-free recurrence until explicit canonical anchor is supplied.
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: No invented timestamp/event.

cases.scenario: A non-frontier historical occurrence completes again while C already exists.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Record permitted new completion attempt for A; retain A-to-B and B-to-C lineage without another successor.
cases.occurrenceEffect: A current binding updated; B/C unchanged
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: New A event distinct from generation receipt; prior reopened event remains uncounted.

cases.scenario: Template node N2 is removed in T2, then visually identical text is added later.
cases.proposedNativeResult: Retire N2; newly added node has N3; never reuse occurrence Step or retired node identity.
cases.occurrenceEffect: Existing occurrences retain their node mapping
cases.stepEffect: New future occurrence allocates fresh Step UUID for N3
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: Template edit receipt does not rewrite past events.

cases.scenario: Initial canonical when-done weekly rule completes early with a known completion instant and fixed series zone.

observedLegacy.claim: See exact installed observation; native proposal may deliberately differ.

cases.proposedNativeResult: Use completion local day in captured series zone, then calendar interval and captured Start/Due offsets.
cases.occurrenceEffect: B new, using captured known instant as evidence only
cases.eventReceiptRelationship: E1 known completedAt retained; generation clock separately recorded.
